title: Gradient rearrangement estimates for singular and degenerate anisotropic $p$-Laplace equations
summary: In this paper, we prove global pointwise estimates on the decreasing rearrangement \(u^{\ast}\) and \([H(\nabla u)]^{\ast}\) of SOLAs \(u\) of an elliptic Poisson equation driven by the anisotropic \(p\)-Laplace operator \(Δ_p^H\) for given \(L^1\)-data and equipped with either homogeneous Dirichlet or Neumann boundary conditions. Here, we assume that the dimension \(n\ge 2\), \(1<p<n\) and \(H\) is norm on \(\R^n\).
